en.t: French abbot Bernard of Clairvaux preached a sermon to a crowd at a council in Vézelay, with King Louis VII in attendance, urging the necessity of a Second Crusade
en.s: The Second Crusade (1147–1149) was the second major crusade launched from Europe. The Second Crusade was started in response to the fall of the County of Edessa in 1144 to the Seljuk forces of Zengi. The county had been founded during the First Crusade (1096–1099) by Baldwin in 1098. While it was the first Crusader state to be founded, it was also the first to fall.

zh.t: 法国修道院院长克莱尔沃的伯尔纳铎在韦泽莱会议上向群众布道，路易七世在场；他呼吁发动第二次十字军东征
zh.s: 第二次十字军东征（1147—1149年）是欧洲发起的第二次大规模十字军东征。1144年，赞吉的塞尔柱军队攻陷埃德萨伯国，由此引发第二次十字军东征。该伯国于1098年第一次十字军东征期间由鲍德温建立，是首个建立的十字军国家，也成为首个沦陷的十字军国家。

en.t: A conspiracy against Saladin, aiming to restore the Fatimid Caliphate, is revealed in Cairo, involving senior figures of the former Fatimid regime and the poet Umara al-Yamani. Modern historians doubt the extent and danger of the conspiracy reported in official sources, but its ringleaders will be publicly executed over the following weeks
en.s: The Fatimid Caliphate (; Arabic: الخلافة الفاطمیّة, romanised: al-Khilāfa al-Fāṭimiyya), also known as the Fatimid Empire, was a caliphate that existed from the tenth to the twelfth centuries CE under the rule of the Fatimids, an Isma'ili Shi'a dynasty. Spanning a large area of North Africa and West Asia, it ranged from the western Mediterranean in the west to the Red Sea in the east.

zh.t: 开罗揭露一场反对萨拉丁、意图恢复法蒂玛哈里发国的阴谋，涉案者包括前法蒂玛政权高层和诗人乌马拉·亚马尼。现代历史学家对官方资料所述阴谋的规模和威胁程度存疑，但主谋将在随后数周内被公开处决
zh.s: 法蒂玛哈里发国（阿拉伯语：الخلافة الفاطمیّة，转写：al-Khilāfa al-Fāṭimiyya），也称法蒂玛帝国，是公元10世纪至12世纪由伊斯玛仪派什叶派王朝法蒂玛家族统治的哈里发国。其疆域横跨北非和西亚大片地区，西起地中海西部，东至红海。

en.t: Pope Gregory X convokes a general church council
en.s: On March 31, 1272, Pope Gregory X convoked a general council to consider union with the Greek Church, a crusade, and church reform. The council met in Lyon in 1274.
en.n: This records the convocation in 1272; the council itself opened in Lyon in 1274.

zh.t: 教宗额我略十世召集大公会议
zh.s: 1272年3月31日，教宗额我略十世召集大公会议，讨论与希腊教会合一、十字军东征和教会改革。会议于1274年在里昂召开。
zh.n: 此条记录1272年的召集决定；会议本身于1274年在里昂开幕。

en.s: The Long Parliament was an English Parliament which nominally lasted from 1640 until 1660, making it the longest-lasting Parliament in English and British history. It followed the fiasco of the Short Parliament, which had convened for only three weeks during the spring of 1640 after an 11-year parliamentary absence. In September 1640, King Charles I issued writs summoning a parliament to convene on 3 November 1640.
en.n: The Long Parliament presents the Humble Petition and Advice offering Oliver Cromwell the British throne, which he eventually declines.

zh.s: 长期议会是英格兰议会，名义上自1640年延续至1660年，是英格兰和英国历史上存续时间最长的议会。它接替了短期议会；短期议会在经历11年没有议会的时期后，于1640年春季召开，但仅持续三周。1640年9月，查理一世颁布诏令，召集议会于同年11月3日开会。
zh.n: 长期议会提交《谦卑请愿与建议书》，提议让奥利弗·克伦威尔登上英国王位；克伦威尔最终拒绝。

en.s: The 1761 Lisbon earthquake struck off the coast of the Portugal on 31 March 1761 at 12:05 local time. Estimated to be around 8.5 on the tsunami magnitude scale, the earthquake was the strongest in the region since 1755, and it was felt across many parts of western Europe. Twenty-five people were killed including several people who died from rockfalls in Madeira and collapsed homes at a village near Porto.
en.n: The 1761 Lisbon earthquake strikes off the Iberian Peninsula with an estimated magnitude of 8.5, six years after another quake destroyed the city.

zh.s: 1761年3月31日当地时间12时05分，里斯本地震发生于葡萄牙近海。地震规模估计约为海啸震级8.5，是1755年地震以来该地区最强的一次，西欧多地均有震感。地震造成25人死亡，其中包括马德拉岛多名被落石砸死的人，以及波尔图附近一座村庄房屋倒塌造成的遇难者。
zh.n: The 1761 Lisbon earthquake strikes off the Iberian Peninsula with an estimated magnitude of 8.5, six years after another quake destroyed the city.

en.s: The 1778 Delaware gubernatorial election was held on March 31, 1778. The delegate to the Continental Congress from Delaware Caesar Rodney was elected president of Delaware for a term of three years. The previous president John McKinly was captured by the British Army in September 1777, less than a year into his three-year term.

zh.s: 1778年3月31日，特拉华州举行行政首长选举。本州派驻大陆会议的代表凯撒·罗德尼，当选任期三年的州总统。前任约翰·麦金利于1777年9月遭英军俘虏，当时其三年任期尚不足一年。

en.s: The Action of 31 March 1800 was a naval engagement of the French Revolutionary Wars fought between a Royal Navy squadron and a French Navy ship of the line off Malta in the Mediterranean Sea. By March 1800 Valletta, the Maltese capital, had been under siege for eighteen months and food supplies were severely depleted, a problem exacerbated by the interception and defeat of a French replenishment convoy in mid-February.

zh.s: 1800年3月31日，法国大革命战争期间，英国皇家海军一支分舰队与一艘法国海军战列舰，在地中海马耳他外海交战。当时马耳他首都瓦莱塔已被围困18个月，粮食严重短缺。2月中旬一支法国补给船队遭拦截击败，使局势更加困难。

en.s: The Battle of Courtrai (31 March 1814) saw Johann von Thielmann's Kingdom of Saxony troops and a few Prussians encounter an Imperial French force under Nicolas Joseph Maison near Kortrijk (Courtrai), a city south-west of Ghent in what is now Belguim. Thielmann attacked only to find himself facing the bulk of Maison's I Corps. The action ended in a rout of the Saxons, most of whom were under fire for the first time.

zh.s: 1814年3月31日，约翰·冯·蒂尔曼率领的萨克森王国军队及少量普鲁士部队，在今比利时根特西南的科特赖克附近，同尼古拉·约瑟夫·梅松指挥的法兰西帝国军交战。蒂尔曼主动进攻后才发现，自己面对的是梅松第一军的主力。萨克森军最终溃败，其中大多数士兵都是第一次经历实战。

en.s: The Battle of Paris or the Storming of Paris (30–31 March 1814) saw the Allied forces of Russia, Austria, Prussia, and Württemberg attack Paris defended by troops of the First French Empire under Joseph Bonaparte. The French soldiers put up a stout resistance at the capital's eastern suburbs on 30 March but were steadily driven back by the overwhelmingly superior Allied forces.

zh.s: 巴黎战役又称巴黎攻城战，于1814年3月30日至31日进行。俄国、奥地利、普鲁士和符腾堡联军进攻巴黎；巴黎由约瑟夫·波拿巴统率的法兰西第一帝国军队防守。3月30日，法军在首都东郊进行了顽强抵抗，但随后逐步被人数占压倒性优势的联军击退。

en.s: The Battle of Dębe Wielkie was fought on 31 March 1831. The Polish army, led by Jan Skrzynecki, won over Russian curtain forces commanded by General Geismar.

en.s: The second battle of Wawer (Polish: druga bitwa pod Wawrem) was an armed engagement between Polish and Imperial Russian troops. It happened on 31 March 1831 during the November Uprising and was one of the first battles of a successful Polish offensive planned by General Ignacy Prądzyński.

zh.s: 第二次瓦韦尔战役（波兰语：druga bitwa pod Wawrem）是波兰军队与俄罗斯帝国军队之间的一场武装交战，于1831年3月31日在十一月起义期间发生。这是伊格纳齐·普龙津斯基将军策划的一次成功反攻中的首批战斗之一。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Chile in 1836. Carried out through a system of electors, they resulted in the re-election of incumbent president Joaquín Prieto. Prieto faced little opposition in this election and was easily re-elected. Manuel Rengifo considered running in the election as a candidate for moderates.

zh.s: 智利于1836年举行总统选举，选举由选举人投票进行，时任总统华金·普列托连任。普列托几乎没有遇到竞争，轻松当选。曼努埃尔·伦吉福曾考虑代表温和派参选。

en.s: The Convention of Kanagawa, also known as the Kanagawa Treaty (神奈川条約, Kanagawa Jōyaku) or the Japan–US Treaty of Peace and Amity (日米和親条約, Nichibei Washin Jōyaku), was a treaty signed between the United States and the Tokugawa Shogunate on March 31, 1854. Signed under threat of force, it effectively meant the end of Japan's 220-year-old policy of national seclusion (sakoku) by opening the ports of Shimoda and Hakodate to American vessels.

zh.s: 《神奈川条约》（又称《日美和亲条约》；日文：神奈川条約、日米和親条約）是美国与德川幕府于1854年3月31日签署的条约。条约是在武力威胁下签署的，实际上结束了日本长达220年的锁国政策，并向美国船只开放下田和箱馆两个港口。

en.s: The first siege of Veracruz was a military encounter of the Reform War which took place around Veracruz, Mexico, in 1859. Conservative President Miguel Miramón attempted to besiege the Liberal capital, Veracruz, but was slowed by guerrilla attacks and forced to withdraw when he received news that a Liberal army was marching on Mexico City. Miramon would try again one year later with similar results in the second siege of Veracruz.

zh.s: 第一次韦拉克鲁斯围城战是改革战争期间的一次军事行动，1859年在墨西哥韦拉克鲁斯附近发生。保守派总统米格尔·米拉蒙试图围攻自由派政府的首都韦拉克鲁斯，但游击队袭击拖慢了行动；得知自由派军队正向墨西哥城进军后，他被迫撤退。一年后，米拉蒙再次围攻韦拉克鲁斯，结果相似。

en.s: The Battle of White Oak Road, also known as The Battle of Hatcher’s Run, Gravelly Run, Boydton Plank Road, White Oak Ridge was fought on March 31, 1865, during the American Civil War at the end of the Richmond-Petersburg Campaign and in the beginning stage of the Appomattox Campaign. Along with the Battle of Dinwiddie Court House which was fought simultaneously on March 31, the battle involved the last offensive action by General Robert E. Lee's Confederate Army of Northern Virginia to stop the progress of Lieutenant General Ulysses S. Grant's Union Army (Army of the Potomac, Army of the Shenandoah and Army of the James).

zh.s: 白橡树路战役又称哈彻溪、格拉夫利溪、博伊德顿木板路或白橡树岭战役，发生于1865年3月31日，时值美国南北战争里士满—彼得斯堡战役末期、阿波马托克斯战役初期。此役与同日进行的丁威迪法院镇战役，构成罗伯特·E.李将军所率北弗吉尼亚邦联军最后一轮进攻，试图阻止尤利西斯·S.格兰特中将统率的联邦军推进。联邦军包括波托马克军团、谢南多厄军团和詹姆斯军团。

en.s: The 1883 Scottish Cup final was the 10th final of the Scottish Cup and the final of the 1882–83 Scottish Cup, the most prestigious knockout football competition in Scotland. The original match - which ended in a 2–2 draw - was played at Hampden Park in Crosshill (today part of Glasgow) on 31 March 1883 and was watched by a crowd of 15,000 spectators.

zh.s: 1883年苏格兰杯决赛是第十届苏格兰杯决赛，也是1882—1883赛季这项苏格兰最重要足球淘汰赛的最后一轮。决赛首场于1883年3月31日在克罗斯希尔的汉普顿公园球场举行，双方2比2战平，现场有1.5万名观众。克罗斯希尔如今属于格拉斯哥。

en.s: The 1883 FA Cup final was an association football match between Blackburn Olympic and Old Etonians on 31 March 1883 at Kennington Oval in London. It was the 12th final of the world's oldest football competition, the Football Association Challenge Cup (commonly known as the FA Cup). Old Etonians were the holders of the Cup, having defeated Olympic's local rivals, Blackburn Rovers, in the 1882 final.

zh.s: 1883年3月31日，布莱克本奥林匹克队与老伊顿生队，在伦敦肯宁顿椭圆球场争夺足总杯冠军。这是世界上历史最悠久的足球赛事——英格兰足球协会挑战杯，通常称为足总杯——的第12届决赛。老伊顿生是卫冕冠军，曾在1882年决赛击败奥林匹克队的同城对手布莱克本流浪者。

en.s: The Pescadores campaign which took place in late March, 1885, was one of the last campaigns of the Sino-French War (August 1884–April 1885). It was fought to capture the Pescadores, a strategically important archipelago off the western coast of Formosa (Taiwan). Admiral Amédée Courbet, with part of the French Far East Squadron, bombarded the Chinese coastal defences around the principal town of Makung on Penghu Island and landed a battalion of marine infantry which routed the Chinese defenders and occupied Makung.

zh.s: 澎湖战役发生于1885年3月下旬，是中法战争（1884年8月—1885年4月）最后几场战役之一。法军为夺取位于台湾西岸外海、具有战略意义的澎湖群岛而展开行动。阿梅代·库尔贝海军上将率领部分法国远东舰队炮击澎湖主岛马公镇周边的中国海防，并派遣海军步兵营登陆，击溃清军守军并占领马公。

en.t: The United Kingdom establishes the Bechuanaland Protectorate
en.s: The Bechuanaland Protectorate () was a protectorate established on 31 March 1885 in Southern Africa by the United Kingdom. It became independent as the Republic of Botswana on 30 September 1966, six years after the Bechuanaland Democratic Party was established, under the leadership of Seretse Khama.

zh.t: 英国建立贝专纳保护国
zh.s: 英国于1885年3月31日在非洲南部建立贝专纳保护国。1966年9月30日，该地独立并成立博茨瓦纳共和国；当时距贝专纳民主党成立已有六年。该党由塞雷茨·卡马领导。

en.s: The 1894 FA Cup final was an association football match between Notts County and Bolton Wanderers at Goodison Park, Liverpool, on 31 March 1894. It was the final match of the 1893–94 edition of the FA Cup, English football's primary cup competition. Bolton Wanderers were appearing in their first final, whereas Notts County were playing in their second, having lost on their previous appearance in 1891.

zh.s: 1894年3月31日，诺茨郡与博尔顿流浪者在利物浦古迪逊公园球场，进行1893—1894赛季足总杯决赛。足总杯是英格兰足球最主要的杯赛。博尔顿首次进入决赛，诺茨郡则是第二次，此前曾在1891年决赛落败。

en.s: The Capture of Malolos, alternately known as the Battle of Malolos, occurred on March 31, 1899, in Malolos, Bulacan, during the Philippine-American War. General Arthur MacArthur, Jr.'s division advanced to Malolos along the Manila–Dagupan Railway. By March 30, American forces were advancing on Malolos. Meanwhile, the Aguinaldo government had moved its seat from Malolos to San Isidro, Nueva Ecija.

zh.s: 1899年3月31日，美菲战争期间，美军攻占布拉干省马洛洛斯，事件也称马洛洛斯战役。小阿瑟·麦克阿瑟将军的师沿马尼拉—达古潘铁路推进，至3月30日已向马洛洛斯逼近。与此同时，阿奎纳多政府已将驻地从马洛洛斯迁至新怡诗夏省圣伊西德罗。

en.s: The First Moroccan Crisis or the Tangier Crisis was an international crisis between March 31, 1905, and April 7, 1906, over the status of Morocco. Germany wanted to challenge France's growing control over Morocco, aggravating France and Great Britain. The crisis was resolved by the Algeciras Conference of 1906, a conference of mostly European countries that affirmed French control; this worsened German relations with both France and Britain and helped enhance the new Anglo-French Entente.

zh.s: 第一次摩洛哥危机又称丹吉尔危机，是一场围绕摩洛哥地位的国际危机，持续时间为1905年3月31日至1906年4月7日。德国试图挑战法国对摩洛哥日益扩大的控制，引发法国和英国不满。1906年阿尔赫西拉斯会议解决了危机；以欧洲国家为主的与会国确认法国对摩洛哥的控制，这进一步恶化了德国与法、英两国的关系，也推动英法协约形成。

en.s: The Third Battle of Topolobampo was a single ship action during the Mexican Revolution. At the end of March 1914, a Constitutionalist gunboat attempted to break the blockade of Topolobampo, Sinaloa after failing in the First and Second Battles of Topolobampo. The Constitutionalist warship, Tampico, was sunk in a battle lasting a few hours by a Huertista gunboat.

zh.t: 第三次托波洛班波海战
zh.s: 第三次托波洛班波海战是墨西哥革命期间的一次单舰交战。1914年3月底，宪政派炮艇在第一、第二次托波洛班波海战失利后，试图突破锡那罗亚州托波洛班波的封锁。宪政派军舰“坦皮科”号在持续数小时的战斗中被韦尔塔派炮艇击沉。

en.t: Treaty of the Danish West Indies
en.s: The Treaty of the Danish West Indies (Danish: Vestindiens traktat), officially the Convention between the United States and Denmark for cession of the Danish West Indies (Danish: Konventionen mellem USA og Danmark), was a 1916 treaty transferring sovereignty of the Danish West Indies from Denmark to the United States in exchange for a sum of US$25,000,000 in gold ($740 million in 2025), and agreement to cede US interest in Greenland.
en.n: According to the terms of the Treaty of the Danish West Indies, the islands become American possessions.

zh.s: 《丹麦西印度群岛条约》（丹麦语：Vestindiens traktat），正式名称为《美国与丹麦关于割让丹麦西印度群岛的公约》（丹麦语：Konventionen mellem USA og Danmark），是 1916 年签订的一项条约。根据条约，丹麦将丹麦西印度群岛的主权移交给美国，以换取 2500 万美元金币（按 2025 年币值约为 7.4 亿美元）；条约还规定丹麦放弃对格陵兰岛的美国利益主张。
zh.n: 根据《丹麦西印度群岛条约》的条款，这些岛屿成为美国属地。

en.s: The First Battle of Amman was fought from 27 to 31 March 1918 during the First Transjordan attack on Amman of the Sinai and Palestine Campaign of the First World War. The 60th (London) Division and the Anzac Mounted Division attacked the Ottoman garrison at Amman deep in enemy occupied territory, 48 kilometres (30 mi) from their front line, after capturing Es Salt and Shunet Nimrin.

en.s: The Battle of Sabilla (29–31 March 1929) was the main battle of the Ikhwan revolt in northern Arabia between the rebellious Ikhwan forces and the army of Abdulaziz al-Saud. It was the last tribal uprising in Arabia. It was also the last major battle in which one side rode camels, as the Ikhwan emphasized radical conservatism and shunned technological modernization.

en.s: The Battle of Anchem (also Battle of Anchiem or Battle of Anchim) was fought between two factions of the Royal family in the Ethiopian Empire (Mangista Iteeyop'p'ya). The battle was fought to determine who would rule the empire, Empress (Nigiste Negest) Zewditu or King (Negus) Tafari Makonnen. The Battle of Anchem is memorable because the pro-Zewditu forces were not openly supported by Empress Zewditu.

zh.s: 安琴战役（又称安奇埃姆战役或安钦战役）是埃塞俄比亚帝国王室两派之间的一场战斗，双方争夺帝国统治权，分别支持女皇祖迪图和国王塔法里·马康南。此战的特别之处在于，支持祖迪图的军队并未得到祖迪图女皇的公开支持。

en.t: 1931 Transcontinental & Western Air Fokker F-10 crash
en.s: On March 31, 1931, a Fokker F-10 belonging to Transcontinental and Western Air crashed near Bazaar, Kansas, after taking off from Kansas City Municipal Airport in Kansas City, Missouri. The scheduled flight was from Kansas City to Los Angeles, with a stopover in Wichita. On this first leg, the wooden structure of one wing failed, causing the aircraft to crash, killing all eight people on board, including Notre Dame football coach Knute Rockne. The investigation found that the wooden wing became moist over time, causing the glue connecting the wing to the fuselage to weaken, allowing the wing to separate.

zh.t: 1931年横贯大陆与西部航空福克F-10空难
zh.s: 1931年3月31日，横贯大陆与西部航空的一架福克F-10飞机，从密苏里州堪萨斯城市立机场起飞后，在堪萨斯州巴扎尔附近坠毁。该定期航班从堪萨斯城飞往洛杉矶，中途经停威奇托。飞机在第一航段中，一侧机翼的木质结构失效，导致坠机。机上八人全部遇难，包括圣母大学橄榄球教练克努特·罗克尼。调查发现，木质机翼长期受潮，使连接机翼与机身的胶水强度下降，最终导致机翼脱落。

en.t: United States Senate special election in Vermont, 1931
en.s: The 1931 United States Senate special election in Vermont took place on March 31, 1931. Republican Warren Austin was elected to the United States Senate to serve the remainder of the deceased Frank L. Greene's term, defeating Democratic candidate Stephen M. Driscoll. Austin replaced Frank C. Partridge, who was appointed to fill the seat until a special election could be held and was defeated in the special primary.

zh.t: 1931年佛蒙特州联邦参议员特别选举

en.s: The 1931 Nicaragua earthquake devastated Nicaragua's capital city of Managua on 31 March 1931. It had a moment magnitude of 6.1 and a maximum MSK intensity of VI (Strong). Between 1,000 and 2,450 people were killed. A major fire started and destroyed thousands of structures, burning into the next day. At least 45,000 were left homeless and losses of $35 million were recorded.

zh.s: 1931年3月31日，尼加拉瓜首都马那瓜遭地震重创。地震矩震级为6.1级，MSK最大烈度为六度（强烈），造成1000至2450人死亡。地震引发大火，烧毁数千座建筑，直到次日仍在燃烧。至少4.5万人无家可归，记录的损失为3500万美元。

en.s: The Battle of Maychew (Italian: Mai Ceu) was the last major battle fought on the northern front during the Second Italo-Ethiopian War. The battle consisted of a failed counterattack by the Ethiopian forces under Emperor Haile Selassie making frontal assaults against prepared Italian defensive positions under the command of Marshal Pietro Badoglio. The battle was fought near Maychew (Mai Ceu), Ethiopia, in the modern region of Tigray.

zh.s: 马伊切乌战役（意大利语：Mai Ceu）是第二次意大利—埃塞俄比亚战争北线的最后一场大型战役。海尔·塞拉西皇帝率领的埃塞俄比亚军队发动反攻，向皮埃特罗·巴多格里奥元帅指挥的意军坚固阵地正面进攻，但未能取胜。战斗发生在埃塞俄比亚马伊切乌附近，位于今天的提格雷地区。

en.s: The Bombing of Durango took place on 31 March 1937, during the Spanish Civil War. On 31 March 1937 the Nationalists started their offensive against the Republican held province of Biscay. The same day the Legion Condor and the Aviazione Legionaria bombed the town of Durango. Around 250 civilians died, among them one priest and fourteen nuns. Durango was the first defenseless European city bombed.

zh.s: 1937年3月31日，西班牙内战期间，国民军开始进攻共和国控制的比斯开省。同一天，德国秃鹰军团和意大利航空志愿军轰炸杜兰戈，造成约250名平民死亡，其中包括一名神父和14名修女。原文称，杜兰戈是欧洲首座遭到轰炸的无防御城市。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Greece on 31 March 1946. The result was a victory for the United Alignment of Nationalists, an alliance that included the People's Party, the National Liberal Party, the Reform Party, which won 206 of the 354 seats in Parliament. As a result Konstantinos Tsaldaris became Prime Minister leading a right-wing coalition. Nonetheless, he soon decided to resign in favor of Themistoklis Sophoulis, who led a government of national unity (conservative and centre-liberal forces) during the entire second phase of the civil war (1946–1949). One of the priorities of the new government was the proclamation of a plebiscite for the restoration of the Greek monarchy.

zh.s: 希腊于1946年3月31日举行议会选举。由人民党、民族自由党及改革党等组成的民族主义者联合阵线，取得354席中的206席，赢得胜利。康斯坦丁诺斯·察尔达里斯由此出任首相，领导右翼联合政府。但他不久后决定辞职，让位给忒米斯托克利斯·索富利斯。原文称，索富利斯领导由保守派和中间自由派组成的民族团结政府，贯穿内战第二阶段（1946—1949年）。新政府的首要任务之一，是宣布举行恢复希腊君主制的公投。

en.s: The Greek Civil War (Greek: Εμφύλιος Πόλεμος, romanized: Emfýlios Pólemos, lit. 'Civil War') took place from 1946 to 1949. The conflict, which erupted shortly after the end of World War II, consisted of a Communist-led uprising against the established government of the Kingdom of Greece. The rebels declared a people's republic, the Provisional Democratic Government of Greece, which was governed by the Communist Party of Greece (KKE) and its military branch, the Democratic Army of Greece (DSE).

zh.s: 希腊内战发生于1946年至1949年，是第二次世界大战结束后不久爆发的一场冲突，由共产党领导的武装起义反抗希腊王国政府。叛军宣布成立希腊临时民主政府，由希腊共产党（KKE）及其军事分支希腊民主军（DSE）管理。

en.s: Provincial Assembly elections were held in the Dominion of Pakistan in 1951 to elect all 192 members of the Provincial Assembly of West Punjab along with other provincial election in North-West Frontier Province. It was Pakistan's first provincial assembly election. Pakistan Muslim League won the election, and defeated the JAML coalition of the Jinnah Muslim League and All-Pakistan Awami Muslim League .

en.s: An election to the County Council of London took place on 31 March 1955. The council was elected by First Past the Post with each elector having three votes in the three-member seats. The Conservative Party made significant gains, but the Labour Party retained a substantial majority. The size of the council was cut by three members, with Fulham East, Fulham West and Hammersmith South abolished, and replaced in part by the new constituencies of Barons Court and Fulham.

zh.s: 1955年3月31日，伦敦郡议会举行选举。选举采用得票领先者当选的制度，每个三议席选区的选民各有三票。保守党席位显著增加，但工党仍保持较大多数。此次议会规模减少三席，富勒姆东、富勒姆西和哈默史密斯南三个选区撤销，部分地区改由新设的男爵宫和富勒姆选区覆盖。

en.s: Territorial Assembly elections were held in Senegal on 31 March 1957. The result was a landslide victory for the Senegalese Popular Bloc (BPS), which won 47 of the 60 seats. Its main competitor, the MSA-affiliated Senegalese Party of Socialist Action (PSAS) had aliented the marabouts and enabled the BPS to win the rural vote (over which the marabouts held an important sway) by far.

zh.s: 塞内加尔于1957年3月31日举行领地议会选举。塞内加尔人民集团赢得60个议席中的47席，大获全胜。其主要对手是隶属非洲社会主义运动的塞内加尔社会主义行动党。后者疏远了当地伊斯兰宗教领袖，而这些领袖对乡村选民影响很大，因此人民集团在农村取得压倒性优势。

en.s: Territorial Assembly elections were held in Guinea on 31 March 1957. The result was a victory for the Democratic Party of Guinea – African Democratic Rally, which won 56 of the 60 seats in the Assembly. Voter turnout was 60.3%.

en.s: The 1958 Canadian federal election was held to elect members of the House of Commons of Canada of the 24th Parliament of Canada on March 31, 1958, just nine months after the 23rd election. It transformed Prime Minister John Diefenbaker's minority into the largest majority government in Canadian history and the second-largest percentage of the popular vote; only Unionist Prime Minister Robert Borden’s triumph in the 1917 federal election, at 56.93 per cent, was higher. Although the Tories would surpass their 1958-seat total in the 1984 election, the 1958 result (achieved in a smaller House) remains unmatched both in terms of percentage of seats (78.5%) and the size of the government majority over all opposition parties (a 151-seat majority).

zh.s: 1958年3月31日，加拿大举行联邦选举，选出第24届议会众议员，距离第23届选举仅九个月。总理约翰·迪芬贝克的少数政府转为加拿大历史上优势最大的多数政府，普选得票率也为当时第二高，仅次于罗伯特·博登领导的联合政府在1917年大选取得的56.93%。保守党后来虽在1984年赢得更多席位，但1958年议会规模较小，因此其78.5%的议席占比，以及比所有反对党合计多151席的优势，按原文记载仍未被打破。

en.s: Elections were held in the state of Western Australia on 31 March 1962 to elect all 50 members to the Legislative Assembly. The Liberal-Country coalition government, led by Premier Sir David Brand, won a second term in office against the Labor Party, led by Opposition Leader Albert Hawke. The election resulted in a confirmation of the status quo, with the only apparent seat changes since the 1959 election being due to the changes of affiliation of the two Independent Liberal members.

zh.s: 西澳大利亚州于1962年3月31日举行选举，选出立法议会全部50名议员。戴维·布兰德爵士领导的自由党—乡村党联合政府击败由反对党领袖阿尔伯特·霍克领导的工党，赢得第二个任期。选举基本维持了原有格局；与1959年选举相比，席位表面上的变化仅来自两名独立自由党议员改变党派归属。

en.s: The Pahang Tua by-election was a state assembly by-election that was held on 31 March 1963 in the state of Pahang, Malaysia. The Pahang Tua seat fell vacant following the death of its UMNO MLA Ahmad Othman on 2nd February 1963. He won the seat in 1959 Malayan general election. Mohammed Mokhtar of Alliance, retained the seat, defeating Abdul Hamid of PMIP and Tengku Jaafar of Socialist Front with an increased majority of 3,291 votes.

zh.s: 1963年3月31日，马来西亚彭亨州彭亨老港州议席举行补选。原巫统议员阿末·奥斯曼于2月2日去世，留下空缺；他曾在1959年马来亚大选中赢得该席。联盟候选人莫哈末·莫达击败泛马伊斯兰党的阿都哈密和社会主义阵线的东姑惹化，以3291票的多数票优势保住席位，并扩大优势。

en.s: Operation Popeye was the advance of the Tiradentes and Caicó detachments of the Brazilian Army and the Military Police of Minas Gerais (PMMG), from Minas Gerais, to Rio de Janeiro and Brasília during the 1964 Brazilian coup d'état. Their rearguard was protected within Minas Gerais by operations Cage and Silence. Ordered by general Olímpio Mourão Filho, from the 4th Military Region/Infantry Division, it was the coup's first military offensive. The Tiradentes Detachment, whose command was given to general Antônio Carlos Muricy, faced loyalist forces from the 1st Army in Rio de Janeiro's territory, under the command of general Luís Tavares da Cunha Melo, from 31 March 1964.

zh.s: “大力水手”行动发生于1964年巴西政变期间。巴西陆军及米纳斯吉拉斯州军警的蒂拉登特斯和凯科分遣队，从米纳斯吉拉斯州向里约热内卢及巴西利亚推进。“牢笼”与“静默”行动在米纳斯吉拉斯州内掩护其后方。第四军区兼步兵师的奥林皮奥·莫朗·菲略将军下令发起行动，这是政变中的首次军事进攻。安东尼奥·卡洛斯·穆里西将军指挥的蒂拉登特斯分遣队，从1964年3月31日起，在里约热内卢境内与路易斯·塔瓦雷斯·达库尼亚·梅洛将军率领的第一集团军忠于政府的部队对峙。

en.s: The 1966 United Kingdom general election on 31 March 1966 was easily won by sitting Labour Prime Minister Harold Wilson. Wilson's decision to call an election turned on the fact that his government, elected a mere 17 months previously in 1964, had an unworkably small majority of only 4 MPs. The Labour government was returned with a much larger majority of 96.

zh.s: 1966年3月31日，现任工党首相哈罗德·威尔逊轻松赢得英国大选。他决定提前选举，是因为1964年上台至今仅17个月的政府，议会多数优势只有四席，难以施政。这次工党再次执政，将多数优势扩大至96席。

en.t: 1966 United Kingdom general election in Scotland
en.s: A general election was held in the United Kingdom on Thursday, 31 March 1966, and all 71 seats in Scotland were contested. The election took place only 17 months after the 1964 United Kingdom general election, with incumbent Prime Minister Harold Wilson deciding to call a snap election since his government had an unworkably small majority of only four MPs.

zh.s: 1966年3月31日星期四，英国举行大选，苏格兰全部71个议席均有竞争。这次选举距1964年大选仅17个月。现任首相哈罗德·威尔逊决定提前选举，是因为政府在议会的多数优势只有四席，难以施政。

en.t: 1966 United Kingdom general election in Northern Ireland
en.s: On 31 March 1966, the 1966 United Kingdom general election was held in Northern Ireland, to elect all 630 members of the House of Commons, including the 12 Northern Ireland seats. The Ulster Unionists lost one seat to Gerry Fitt, leader of the new Republican Labour Party. In the election as a whole, the Labour Party increased their majority and Harold Wilson continued as Prime Minister.

en.s: General elections were held in Belgium on 31 March 1968. The Christian Social Party remained the largest party. Voter turnout was 90.0%. Elections for the nine provincial councils were also held. The snap elections were called after the government, a coalition of the Cristian Social Party and the liberal Party for Freedom and Progress led by Christian democrat Paul Vanden Boeynants, fell due to the Leuven Crisis. The linguistic crisis would trigger the split of the dominant Christian Social Party into a Flemish and French-speaking party. The two other main parties would follow suit.

zh.s: 比利时于1968年3月31日举行大选，基督教社会党继续保持第一大党地位，投票率为90.0%。九个省的省议会也同期改选。此次提前大选的原因，是保罗·范登布伊南茨领导的基督教社会党与自由进步党联合政府，因鲁汶危机倒台。这场语言冲突促使占主导地位的基督教社会党分裂为荷兰语党和法语党，另外两个主要政党此后也走上分裂道路。

en.s: The Abagana Ambush (31 March 1968) was an ambush during the Nigerian Civil War by Biafran troops led by Major Jonathan Uchendu that wiped out the Nigerian 2nd Division. en.t: Withdrawal of Lyndon B. Johnson from the 1968 United States presidential election
en.s: On March 31, 1968, incumbent U.S. president Lyndon B. Johnson made a surprise announcement during a televised address to the nation that began around 9 p.m., declaring that he would not seek re-election for another term and was withdrawing from the 1968 United States presidential election. en.s: Operation Jeb Stuart was a U.S. Army operation during the Vietnam War that took place in Quảng Trị and Thừa Thiên Provinces from 21 January to 31 March 1968. en.s: The Birmingham Stechford by-election, in Birmingham, on 31 March 1977 was held after Labour Member of Parliament (MP) Roy Jenkins resigned his seat following his appointment as President of the European Commission. A seat that had been solidly Labour since its formation in 1950, it was won by Andrew MacKay of the Conservative Party, before being regained by Labour in 1979. The by-election was noted for the strong performance of the National Front candidate and the presence of two far left candidates.

zh.t: 1977年伯明翰斯特奇福德选区补选
zh.s: 1977年3月31日，英国伯明翰斯特奇福德选区举行补选。原工党议员罗伊·詹金斯获任欧洲委员会主席后辞去议席。这个选区自1950年设立以来一直稳固支持工党，但此次由保守党的安德鲁·麦凯赢得，工党直到1979年才夺回。国民阵线候选人的强劲表现，以及两名极左翼候选人参选，都使这次补选受到关注。

en.s: Operation Seiljag was a South African 32 Battalion search and destroy campaign conducted against the People's Liberation Army of Namibia (PLAN) from November 1976 to March 1977, during the South African Border War. en.s: The eleven year siege of Khost took place throughout the nine-year Soviet–Afghan War in the 1980s and the subsequent Afghan civil war in the 1990s. en.s: TAROM Flight 371 was an Airbus A310 that crashed near Baloteşti in Romania on 31 March 1995. It was a flight from Bucharest's main Otopeni airport to Brussels. The flight crashed shortly after it took off. Two main reasons are indicated: first the throttle of the starboard engine jammed, remaining in takeoff thrust, while the other engine reduced slowly to idle, creating an asymmetrical thrust condition that ultimately caused the aircraft to roll over and crash.

The Islamist rebels had a death toll of 600 to over 800, with as many as a thousand in total on both sides.

en.t: American singer-songwriter Selena, known as the "queen of Tejano music", was murdered by the president of her fan club, Yolanda Saldívar, in Corpus Christi, Texas, deeply affecting the Latino community
en.s: On the morning of March 31, 1995, American singer Selena Quintanilla-Pérez was fatally shot at the Days Inn in Corpus Christi, Texas. The shooter, Yolanda Saldívar, an American nurse and the president of Selena's fan club, had embezzled thousands of dollars from the singer's earnings. Saldívar planned the murder over three weeks. Earlier in the day, Selena confronted Saldívar in her hotel room about recovering her financial records.

en.s: WrestleMania XII was the twelfth annual WrestleMania professional wrestling event produced by the World Wrestling Federation. In his return to the company after a four-year hiatus, The Ultimate Warrior defeated Hunter Hearst Helmsley. Roddy Piper competed in his first match since 1994, after which he left for WCW.

en.s: A parliamentary election was held in Zimbabwe on 31 March 2005 to elect members to the Zimbabwe House of Assembly. All of the 120 elected seats in the 150-seat House of Assembly were up for election. (In addition, there were 20 members appointed by the President and ten elected by the traditional chiefs, who mostly support the government. en.t: The dwarf planet Makemake is discovered by a team led by astronomer Michael E. Brown at the Palomar Observatory
en.s: Makemake (minor-planet number 136472) is a dwarf planet orbiting the Sun in the Kuiper belt, a disc of icy bodies beyond the orbit of Neptune. It is the fourth largest dwarf planet and trans-Neptunian object in the Solar System, having a diameter 60% that of Pluto. It was discovered on March 31, 2005, by American astronomers Michael E. Brown, Chad Trujillo, and David Rabinowitz at Palomar Observatory.

zh.s: 美国天文学家迈克尔·E·布朗、查德·特鲁希略和戴维·拉比诺维茨于2005年3月31日在帕洛马天文台发现矮行星鸟神星（小行星编号136472）。鸟神星绕太阳运行，位于海王星轨道之外、由冰质天体组成的柯伊伯带中。它是太阳系第四大的矮行星和海王星外天体，直径约为冥王星的60%。

en.t: 2009 New York's 20th congressional district special election
en.s: On March 31, 2009, New York held a special election to fill a vacancy in its 20th congressional district. en.s: The Battle of Markada (also spelled "Markadah" or "Markadahin") was a military confrontation between two jihadist groups, al-Qaeda's al-Nusra Front and the Islamic State (ISIS), over the town of Markada in the Al-Hasakah Governorate, in March 2014 during the Syrian civil war. The strategic importance of the town to the ISIS lay in its position on the group's weapons supply route from Iraq, the road linking Al-Hasakah with Deir ez-Zor and a hill that dominates the surrounding area.

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Ukraine on 31 March 2019. As none of the 39 candidates on the ballot received an absolute majority of the initial vote, a runoff was held on 21 April between the top two vote-getters: Volodymyr Zelenskyy, a television personality, and Petro Poroshenko, the incumbent president. The Central Election Commission (CEC) announced that Zelenskyy won the second round with 73.22% of the total vote (or 74.96% of the valid vote).

zh.s: 乌克兰于2019年3月31日举行总统选举。选票上的39名候选人均未取得绝对多数，因此得票最高的电视艺人弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基与现任总统彼得罗·波罗申科，于4月21日进行第二轮决选。中央选举委员会宣布，泽连斯基获得总票数的73.22%，即有效票的74.96%，赢得第二轮选举。

en.s: The Turkish local elections of 2019 were held on Sunday 31 March 2019 throughout the 81 provinces of Turkey. A total of 30 metropolitan and 1,351 district municipal mayors, alongside 1,251 provincial and 20,500 municipal councillors were elected, in addition to numerous local non-partisan positions such as neighbourhood representatives (muhtars) and elderly people's councils.

en.s: Mayoral elections were held in the Turkish province of İzmir as part of nationwide local elections on 31 March 2019. A total of 31 mayors, one for each of the 30 districts of İzmir and one for the İzmir Metropolitan Municipality, were elected. Republican People's Party (CHP) candidate Tunç Soyer, the former Mayor of Seferihisar, was elected as Mayor of the İzmir Metropolitan Municipality, beating Justice and Development Party (AK Party) candidate Nihat Zeybekci by 58.1% to 38.7%.

en.s: The 2019 EFL Trophy Final was a football match played at Wembley Stadium on 31 March 2019. It decided the winners of the 2018–19 EFL Trophy, the 35th edition of the competition, a knock-out tournament for the 48 teams in League One and League Two and 16 category one academy sides. en.s: Local elections in Turkey took place throughout the country's 81 provinces on 31 March 2024. A total of 30 metropolitan and 1,363 district municipal mayors, alongside 1,282 provincial and 21,001 municipal councilors were elected, in addition to numerous local non-partisan positions such as neighborhood representatives (muhtars) and elderly people's councils.

zh.s: 土耳其于2024年3月31日在全国81个省举行地方选举。选民选出30名大都市市长、1,363名区级市长、1,282名省议员和21,001名市议员，也选出大量无党派地方职位人员，包括街区代表（muhtar）和长者委员会成员。

en.s: Local elections were held in the Turkish province of Antalya as part of nationwide local elections on 31 March 2024. 20 mayors were elected, 19 for each of the districts of Antalya, and one for the Antalya Metropolitan Municipality. Municipal councils for the 19 district municipalities and the Antalya Metropolitan Municipality were also elected. The incumbent mayor of the metropolitan municipality, Muhittin Böcek, retained his position with a plurality.

zh.s: 安塔利亚省于2024年3月31日举行地方选举，作为全国地方选举的一部分。选出20名市长，其中19人负责安塔利亚各区，1人负责安塔利亚大都市区；此外，还选出了19个区和大都市区的市议会。时任大都市区市长穆希廷·博切克以相对多数票保住职位。

en.s: Istanbul, Turkey's largest city, held mayoral elections on 31 March 2024 as part of the 2024 Turkish local elections. Incumbent mayor Ekrem İmamoğlu was re-elected with an absolute majority (51.21%) of the vote.

zh.s: 土耳其最大城市伊斯坦布尔于2024年3月31日举行市长选举，作为2024年土耳其地方选举的一部分。时任市长埃克雷姆·伊马姆奥卢以绝对多数（51.21%）的得票率连任。

en.s: Local elections took place in İzmir, the third largest city of Turkey, on 31 March 2024, as part of nationwide local elections. A metropolitan municipal mayor was elected alongside mayors and councillors for the districts of İzmir. The governing People's Alliance, formed of the Justice and Development Party (AK Party) and the Nationalist Movement Party (MHP), fielded AK Party Member of Parliament Hamza Dağ as their candidate.

zh.s: 土耳其第三大城市伊兹密尔于2024年3月31日举行地方选举，作为全国地方选举的一部分。除选出大都市区市长外，也选出了伊兹密尔各区的市长和议员。执政的人民联盟由正义与发展党（AK党）和民族主义行动党（MHP）组成，提名正义与发展党议员哈姆扎·达为候选人。

en.s: Mayoral elections were held in the Turkish province of Kütahya as part of nationwide local elections on 31 March 2024. Despite being considered a conservative province, the election in the central district of Kütahya resulted in a surprise victory for the secular centre-left Republican People's Party (CHP), which narrowly won against the incumbent nationalist Nationalist Movement Party (MHP).

zh.s: 土耳其屈塔希亚省于2024年3月31日举行市长选举，作为全国地方选举的一部分。屈塔希亚通常被视为保守派省份，但省会所在的中央区选举结果出人意料：世俗的中左翼共和人民党（CHP）以微弱优势击败时任市长所属的民族主义行动党（MHP）。

en.s: Local elections were held in Bursa, a metropolitan province of Turkey, on 31 March 2024 alongside nationwide local elections. Elections were held for the metropolitan municipal mayor of Bursa, as well as district mayors and councillors of Bursa's 17 districts. The governing People's Alliance, formed by the Justice and Development Party (AK Party) and the smaller Nationalist Movement Party (MHP), nominated incumbent Mayor Alinur Aktaş for re-election.

zh.s: 土耳其大都市省布尔萨于2024年3月31日举行地方选举，作为全国地方选举的一部分。选举选出布尔萨大都市区市长，以及该省17个区的市长和议员。执政的人民联盟由正义与发展党（AK党）和较小的民族主义行动党（MHP）组成，提名时任市长阿利努尔·阿克塔什竞选连任。
